changelog:
amazon-review-insights v1.2.4

- Removed the skill-card.md file for a more streamlined repository.
- Updated documentation to clarify that both the desktop client (recommended) and the browser extension can serve as review collection channels, with emphasis on confirming the online status of collection devices.
- Improved installation and troubleshooting instructions for setting up and verifying the collection channel.
- No functional or API changes were introduced in this version.
summary: Amazon product review intelligence analysis tool for global e-commerce sellers. Core capabilities:fetch Amazon reviews, AI-powered negative review analysis, quantify high-frequency issues, discover hidden negative feedback in 5-star reviews, generate improvement suggestions, track review trends, inc
